from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's total current liabilities reported in a financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name, as named in the report")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/securities code if provided")
    total_current_liabilities: float | None = Field(description="The '流动负债合计' amount in yuan")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="The report period-end date")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt showing the liability figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    liability_records: list[CompanyLiabilityRecord]
